title: Nine Streets of Registering
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：citizen　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 citizen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 my mother was sent to register ① citizen she could not find, and she said the registering was the whole of the lesson. The ② citizen, meaning the person and not the right, was nine streets away and was registered by whoever came last; citizen, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ citizen in that town had the same paper, and the ④ citizen at the end, meaning the one the clerk kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever registered properly. Citizen, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ citizen was the whole of the vote, meaning the duty it carried and not the person. The ⑥ citizen, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a vote that everybody claims and nobody questions; citizen, he said, is either something you register or the only word that means both a person and a duty. She said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ citizen had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the paper. The ⑧ citizen of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine streets and eleven years of registering; citizen, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ citizen I remember is the one at the end, which was registered in 1970 and is still described as the oldest in the county. A ⑩ citizen, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being registered; every citizen, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like a person. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 公民（指那个人本身，与那份权利相对）
C. 固定搭配：register a citizen 登记一位公民
D. n. 公民（指镇上每一位）
E. n. 公民（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 公民责任（抽象：它承载的那份义务）
G. n. 那份义务（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The citizen, meaning the person and not the right
citizen was the whole of the vote
the citizen had become a number in a report
The citizen of the whole thing
A citizen, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: register a citizen 意为“登记一位公民”，1950 年母亲被派去登记她找不到的那位公民。
citizen 意为“公民、市民”，指那个人本身而不是那份权利，隔着九条街，由最后来的人登记。
citizen 指镇上每一位公民，每一位都是同样的证件。
citizen 指末尾那一位（书记员保留的那一位），是唯一有人认真登记过的。
citizen 意为“公民责任”，抽象指它承载的那份义务，父亲说 citizen 就是那次投票的全部。
citizen 为抽象用法，指那份义务本身，是一次投票里人人都主张、却没人质疑的东西。
citizen 意为“公民、市民”，到 1965 年这位 citizen 成了报告里的一个数字。
citizen 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九条街和十一年的登记。
citizen 意为“公民”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1970 年登记，至今仍被说成全县最年长的。
citizen 为抽象总称，祖母说一位公民是唯一会因为被认真登记而变好的东西。
